arguments.value: URS Corporation and JANA Partners agreed to end their dispute and work together. URS will add four JANA-backed independent directors to its board, expand the board to 14 before the March 2014 meeting, then reduce it to 12 after the annual meeting. The board will nominate and recommend these directors at the 2014 annual meeting, and JANA will support the company’s full slate and help ensure quorum. URS will create a Value Creation Committee, give JANA nominees seats on the CEO succession and compensation committees, and avoid major transactions or acquisitions without agreed limits. JANA agrees to stand still during the cooperation period, not run a proxy fight, not seek more control or more than 14.9% ownership, not disparage URS, and support the board nominees. Both sides agreed to public disclosure, confidentiality, and mutual non-disparagement, and the agreement ends at the end of the cooperation period.
